install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p ~/.local/bin; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo fetch --locked 2>/dev/null || true; fi
